yt_title: Why Do Wombats Poop Cubes? The Real Reason #Shorts
desc: Wombats are the only known animal to make cube-shaped droppings. Scientists found that the shape comes from stretchy parts of their intestines. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Cube poop is real science! 🐨 Follow for a fact every day. Send this to someone curious! Comment CUBE

lines.text: Why do wombats poop cubes? It is real science.
They are the only known animal that does it.
A wombat can leave dozens of cubes in one night.
Their intestine stretches in some parts and stays stiff in others.
Scientists think cubes stay put on rocks to mark territory. Round ones would roll away.
